changes: Slide mode now follows your finger — drag a slide and it moves with you, with a gentle resistance at the ends; flick to turn the page, and it springs back if you change your mind.
A soft light follows your cursor across cards and tiles on desktop, and sections quietly rise into view as you scroll.
The splash screen now shows the full image — never cropped — with aurora lights and twinkling stars glowing behind it and a ring that counts the seconds.
The bottom dock is cleaner — icon-only tabs until you land on one: the active tab grows into a colored pill and reveals its name.
Every counter tap sends a gentle ring out from the number.
A completely new body — the app now lives on a living gradient canvas: soft aurora lights drift slowly behind every screen, in every theme.
The header is now a floating glass bar that hovers over the content instead of a solid colored strip; the Hijri strip nests inside it as a quiet hairline row.
Tonight's moon — computed from the Hijri calendar data — shows as an animated moon with its real phase on the home date card and on the Calendar page, including how much of it is illuminated.
Explore tiles glow with vivid rotating colors, deeper shadows and a soft film grain give every theme a modern gallery feel.
Opening a book now animates its cover from the library grid straight into the reader.
Refreshed typography: bolder display headings, cleaner uppercase section labels, and roomier rounded surfaces throughout.
Smooth page transitions — pages glide in whenever you switch tabs or open a new section, in every theme.
Slide mode moves with you: the next slide enters from the side you're heading toward — forward or back.
The zikr counter now rolls each number into place as you tap + or −.
Gentle shimmer placeholders replace the plain 'Loading...' text, so pages preview their layout while content arrives.
Copying a share link shows a soft confirmation pill at the top instead of a browser popup.
The 'today' card on Home glows with a slow drifting light.
Finer touches: slim scrollbars, a better fit on mobile browsers, and more balanced line breaks in headings and paragraphs.
New full-screen menu — the top-left button now opens a clean, numbered list of every section with smooth staggered animations.
Home is now a dashboard: today's Hijri date and event at the top, a continue-reading shortcut for the book you were last reading, and a daily rotating dua.
Focus reading mode — tap the new expand button beside the counter to hide the header and bottom bar entirely while you read; tap again to bring them back.
The header now slides away as you read downward and returns as soon as you scroll up, with a thin progress line showing how far you've read.
Content pages get arched hero headers with a subtle star pattern, inspired by mihrab architecture.
Complete visual redesign — a brand-new look for the whole app, in every theme: soft gradient accents, luminous surfaces, and refined typography throughout.
Floating glass navigation dock replaces the old bottom bar; the Home page gets a new wordmark hero with a star-and-crescent motif.
Content pages redesigned: borderless elevated cards with gradient accent rails and numbered badges, refreshed hero headers with gradient titles.
Counter and slide controls now float in a glass capsule above the navigation, neatly sized for small phones.
Settings, Quick Jump and the walkthrough open as modern bottom sheets with grab handles; splash screen shows a circular countdown badge.
Changelog timeline, About version card and the 404 page receive the new gradient styling.
Complete UI refresh across the remaining pages: Duas, Khatm-e-Khwajagan, Fateha Khwani, Roshni, Sijrah Nama, and About now use modern hero headers and neatly numbered cards.
Changelog page redesigned as a timeline with version chips and a 'Latest' badge.
Subtle vibration feedback (on supported devices) for tab, slide, counter, and settings taps.
The walkthrough (tour) now shows a progress bar, and the Settings popup has cleaner icon buttons for List/Slide view.
Refreshed 404 page and a gently zooming splash screen; the About page now links straight to the changelog.
Complete UI Revamp across key pages: Calendar, Biographies, Books, Home, and Settings.
Interactive Calendar day inspector sheet with event filtering and instant search across 2,360+ occasions.
Modern hero headers and structured chronology timeline layout for biographical histories (HMK, Salim Pappa, Abbajaan).
Elevated Books library grid cards with cover spine accents and clean reading progress bar.
Polished Home quick-links grid with tactile feedback and refreshed Settings popup modal.
Added new Dua: 'Khwaja, The Refuge of the Destitute' ('Ghareebon Ke Sahare, Khwaja') in English and Hinglish.
Home page tile icons now follow your theme's accent color — in Teal, Indigo, Gold and other accent themes the tile icons pick up the same tint as the bottom navigation.
Reading sizes adjusted for easier reading — Small/Medium/Large/X-Large are slightly larger (16–22px), while X-Small and XX-Large stay as they were.
Two home tiles got clearer icons: the Duas tile now shows a mosque and the Khatm tile a star.
The home page quick-link tiles are now customizable — tiles can be added, removed, reordered, and given new icons. Tile labels always follow the page names, so they stay translated automatically.
Four new warm-gradient themes — Gold, Silver, Beige, and Amber — added to Settings. The header takes on a subtle gradient sheen to match.
New Books section — read the written works of Hajee Mahboob Kassim (9 books now, more coming). Each book has chapters, quick chapter jumping, list or slide view, reading progress, and easy sharing.
A dedicated Books page with cover cards to browse the library.
Fixed: events happening today no longer appear twice — once in Today's Events and again in Upcoming Events.
Three new themes! Indigo, Teal, and a true-black OLED dark mode that saves battery on OLED screens.
Theme picker now shows colored swatch circles at a glance, instead of text buttons.

A friendly guided tour now welcomes first-time visitors — choose your language, then walk through the home cards, reading, counter and navigation. You can skip it, or replay it any time from Settings; when you finish, you land back on the home page.
Calendar now shows ALL of today's events (split into Monthly and Other) instead of just the next event
